description: This file defines the class 'bugzilladbInterface', which provides an interface to a Bugzilla issue tracker within a testing and issue management environment. It contains methods for retrieving bug issues, checking bug status and existence, and configuration templates for the interface setup.

classes.name: bugzilladbInterface
classes.description: A class extending issueTrackerInterface to integrate with Bugzilla via database connection, providing methods to retrieve bug data, check status, and generate configuration templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes connection settings and default statuses if connected.

methods.name: getissue
methods.description: Fetches details for a specific bug ID from the database and returns an object with bug details.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the specified bug or null if not connected or bug not found.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks and returns 1 if a bug with the specified ID exists in the database, otherwise 0.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the format of a bug ID using a numeric check.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the PHP interface configuration setting.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides an XML template string for configuring the Bugzilla interface.
